summary: The cursed wand reaches zap.c:dozap's backfire branch at step 207. JavaScript throws UnsupportedZapError instead of running the existing C backfire sequence, so the recorded screen is missing and the C d(70,6) call at RNG index 2429 is absent. Port the whole zap.c:backfire function and call it from dozap before exercise(A_STR, FALSE) and ECMD_TIME.

source.branch: After dozap successfully selects and charges a cursed wand, the WAND_BACKFIRE_CHANCE draw returns zero, so dozap calls backfire before the direction prompt or other wand effect.
callers: zap.c:dozap at 2648 is the sole direct C caller; js/cmd.js:dozap dispatches production commands to js/zap.js:dozap.
dependencies: hack.c:losehp, implemented in js/hack.js; the backfire caller discards its return value.
invent.c:useupall, implemented in js/invent.js with existing source-completion evidence; the backfire caller discards its return value.
rng.c:d and zap.c:Maybe_Half_Phys, used to preserve source damage and random-call order.

evidence: The saved v52 queue identifies challenges/manifests/v52.json with canonical manifest SHA-256 38c5e274ac970a16df08fb372269edc360f8c61f507020f29f71d9335ea9f29e, this recording SHA-256 c031d9b0879034b6ee6302240114bccf104c3ec0749a36b3686fdb168cd0a11f, and evaluation challenges/evaluations/hosted-38292091033-1-v52.json measured at fcfb7afe71226851b75665b753b0c2c73ceb7af4.

The saved fresh-differential log reports the first mismatch at segment 0, step 207, key 'o': JavaScript has no screen at that step; C calls d(70,6)=234 in backfire(zap.c:2611) at RNG index 2429. The saved baseline has 207/1103 screens and cursors matched and 2429/2438 RNG entries matched.

nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:2605-2614 defines the complete backfire body: set otmp->in_use, print the explosion message, roll d(otmp->spe + 2, 6), pass Maybe_Half_Phys(dmg) to losehp with killer name 'exploding wand' and KILLED_BY_AN, then consume the wand with useupall.

nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:2647-2653 calls backfire after zappable() and the conditional WAND_BACKFIRE_CHANCE draw, then exercises strength and returns ECMD_TIME without the ordinary inventory-update tail.
js/zap.js:875-900 contains the matching dozap control flow but throws UnsupportedZapError at the backfire arm. js/cmd.js:3342-3347 reaches dozap from the production command dispatcher.

js/hack.js:1335-1390 implements losehp and its human HP/death path used by this recording. js/invent.js:4955-4973 implements useupall; GOALS.json records source review and caller/test evidence for invent.c:useupall. This task does not claim whole hack.c:losehp completion.

The complete implementation scope is zap.c:backfire as a whole function plus the existing dozap call site in js/zap.js. The caller keeps the existing charge, backfire-probability draw, strength exercise, and ECMD_TIME order.
